close_reason: fixed: handle_email_get and handle_email_parse both insert id into effective_props before filter_properties when properties is explicitly specified
description: In handle_email_parse (email.rs ~L1812-1820), when properties is Some([...]), effective_props is built from regular_props without inserting 'id'. filter_properties then omits 'id' from parsed Email objects. RFC 8620 §5.1 requires id to always be present. Trigger: Email/parse with properties=['subject'] → parsed Email objects in the 'parsed' map have no 'id' field. DEFAULT_EMAIL_PARSE_PROPERTIES also omits 'id' (lines 56-74), so even the default case does not include it.
title: Email/parse drops 'id' when properties list is specified
